exemplars.paper_id: LARA_ A Light and Anti-overfitting Retraining Approach for Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
exemplars.key_insight: 旧模型是历史数据的抽象，可从中恢复历史数据指导潜向量微调；线性调整函数数学上最优且开销最小
exemplars.method_signature: 基于VAE的轻量抗过拟合重训练框架，包含ruminate block恢复历史知识和线性调整函数Mz、Mx

exemplars.paper_id: Learning Multi-Pattern Normalities in the Frequency Domain for Efficient Time Series Anomaly Detection
exemplars.key_insight: 通过样本与服务正常模式的相关性检测异常，而非仅依赖样本自身；利用频域稀疏性选择子集傅里叶基可提升检测性能
exemplars.method_signature: MACE：模式提取机制+双卷积(峰/谷)+上下文感知DFT/IDFT

exemplars.paper_id: Edge Intelligence with Spiking Neural Networks
exemplars.key_insight: SNN通过模拟生物神经元动力学，以事件驱动计算替代昂贵的MAC操作，可成为边缘智能的低功耗替代方案
exemplars.method_signature: 首个EdgeSNN综合调研，系统梳理神经元模型、学习算法、硬件平台及部署挑战

exemplars.paper_id: SAFA-SNN_ Sparsity-Aware On-Device Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning with Fast-Adaptive Structure of Spiking Neural Network
exemplars.key_insight: 通过阈值调控将神经元分为稳定和自适应两类，使大多数突触权重自然保持，仅少数更新，从而保留基类知识。
exemplars.method_signature: 阈值动态调节+零阶优化+原型正交子空间投影的联合框架

exemplars.paper_id: Darkit_ A User-Friendly Software Toolkit for Spiking Large Language Model
exemplars.key_insight: 通过统一GUI和自动化工具降低spiking LLM的研究门槛比改进算法更紧迫
exemplars.method_signature: 提供10项功能的集成化工具包，含GUI可视化与代码编辑器

exemplars.paper_id: Frequency Matching in Spiking Neural Networks for mmWave Sensing
exemplars.key_insight: LIF dynamics act as implicit low-pass filter; matching effective bandwidth to discriminative spectral content of mmWave signals enables inherent noise suppression
exemplars.method_signature: Frequency-matching criterion for configuring membrane decay factor β by aligning LIF effective bandwidth with discriminative spectrum

exemplars.paper_id: ECC-SNN_ Cost-Effective Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Spiking Neural Networks
exemplars.key_insight: 用云端大ANN作为oracle通过知识蒸馏指导边缘小SNN，并让边缘通过增量学习自主减少对云的依赖
exemplars.method_signature: ANN-SNN联合训练( logits +特征对齐损失 ) + 熵阈值过滤协作推理 + 自蒸馏增量学习

exemplars.paper_id: Exploiting Label Skewness for Spiking Neural Networks in Federated Learning
exemplars.key_insight: Separate intra-client label calibration for majority/minority imbalance from inter-client knowledge distillation for missing labels; global model as teacher preserves correct optimization direction
exemplars.method_signature: FedLEC: calibrated cross-entropy Lc balances intra-client label learning; KL-divergence distillation loss Ld transfers global distribution for missing labels; ATT aggregation across time steps

exemplars.paper_id: Federated Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models__oa_W4412887984
exemplars.key_insight: 融合不同Transformer层特征进行聚类,结合层级化选择(先客户端内聚类再服务器端聚类)可在保护隐私同时实现高效数据筛选

exemplars.paper_id: Federated Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models__oa_W4403573412
exemplars.key_insight: Fusing features from all Transformer layers via t-SNE beats last-layer-only; hierarchical intra→inter clustering eliminates inter-client redundancy
exemplars.method_signature: FedHDS: hierarchical data selection via fused multi-layer features + HDBSCAN clustering

exemplars.paper_id: LSHFed_ Robust and Communication-Efficient Federated Learning with Locally-Sensitive Hashing Gradient Mapping

exemplars.paper_id: Sequential Recommendation Based on Multivariate Hawkes Process Embedding With Attention

exemplars.paper_id: Trust-based Service Recommendation in Social Network
